en: The front of the postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a garden or park area bustling with people in early 20th-century attire. There is a fountain or pond in the foreground with manicured flower beds and walking paths. A large number of people are strolling or seated, and there is an arched structure in the background that appears to be a concert pavilion or bandstand. The surrounding area is lush with mature trees. The bottom of the image has fine printed text with location information.
